# Kai Marketing OS

> Kai Marketing OS adds `/kai` marketing skills to Codex and agent workspaces. Kai reads a repo, creates `MARKETING.md`, then runs audits, plans, briefs, landing pages, ad campaigns, SEO audits, content calendars, quality gates, and approvals.

## Public Pages

- `/` - public product homepage for `/kai` skills, first-run setup, SEO commands, stage paths, KaiCalls, MeetKai, FAQ, and sign-in.
- `/llms.txt` - crawler and agent summary.
- `/auth/callback` - authentication callback.

## Primary /kai Skills

- `/kai-start` - first-run setup. Reads the repo, creates `MARKETING.md`, and recommends the first useful command.
- `/kai` - command router. Shows the marketing skills by Make, Check, Plan, and Learn.
- `/kai-audit` - full marketing audit across checklists.
- `/kai-seo-audit` - technical SEO audit with prioritized fixes.
- `/kai-topical-map` - topic and content architecture planning.
- `/kai-surround-sound` - plan mentions and citations for AI answer visibility.
- `/kai-growth-plan` - stage-specific marketing plan.
- `/kai-landing-page` - landing page copy and conversion structure.
- `/kai-ad-campaign` - paid campaign plan and assets.
- `/kai-content-calendar` - month or quarter of SEO and channel content.
- `/kai-gate` - Four U's, banned words, SEO lint, policy checks, and approval state.

## Private Surfaces

- `/dashboard` - marketing health score, recommended actions, attention items, and run history.
- `/actions` - proposed marketing changes that need review or approval.
- `/content` - approved content, drafts, and completed work.
- `/analytics` - website, SEO, ads, email, and channel performance.
- `/connect` - integrations for analytics, ads, CRM, email, site data, and phone lead capture.
- `/settings` - workspace settings.

## Core Topics

- Codex marketing skills
- `/kai` skills
- AI CMO harness
- SEO audit software
- AI search and AEO visibility
- Content approval workflow
- MeetKai marketing dashboard
- KaiCalls missed-call answering and phone lead qualification

## Agent Access

- Public crawlers may read `/`, `/llms.txt`, and public assets.
- Authenticated dashboard routes are not public documentation.
- API routes are blocked from crawlers.
- Source docs live at `https://github.com/cgallic/kai-cmo-harness`.
